judgments.claim: For an argument whose llmBaseUrl equals the US registry declaration, searchUrl constructs https://llm.kimchi.dev/v1/search.
judgments.rationale: The selected declaration supplies https://llm.kimchi.dev. The complete searchUrl body returns that argument property followed by /v1/search.
judgments.scope: Direct evaluation of searchUrl with the selected declared value; excludes effective configuration, overrides, callers, execution and server availability.
